item.title: Same to Ikiru Nanokakan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CUBE
  • 発売日: 2022-11-25
  • スコア: 7.67/10 (232 人評価)
  • 日本語名: サメと生きる七日間
  • 英語名: Same to Ikiru Nanokakan

别名

  • サメナナ

あらすじ

One night, Fukami Kyouhei suddenly found himself lying on an unfamiliar beach. Looking around, all he saw were the vast ocean and sandy beach…… Drowning in confusion, other than that, he also felt something strange on his head and when he fearfully checked it out——

“Agu, Agu”

A naked girl with a shark-like appearance was biting Kyouhei’s head. Surprised by that moment, he fled from that spot, and this time, even though it was still in the middle of the night, he thought that he saw a girl in a bathing suit.

别名

  • End of Summer

あらすじ

Summer in the countryside, rich in nature. The end of the world for two people.

After graduating from college, Yuuji found a job, but had to retire after less than a year due to physical problems he got from his workplace.

After much consideration, he decided to move to his grandparents’ house in the countryside, which was vacant.

别名

  • What Happens if I Who Can Use Magic Live in a Girls Dormitory‛？!

あらすじ

–Minato Dormitory, a women’s dormitory.

Located in the neighborhood of the historic Shiraki Private Academy, the dormitory is managed by the cousin of the protagonist Yasaka Yuuki. It is an uncommon dormitory with a café where students working as waitresses are dress up as maids. Yuuki has been helping with the dormitory work since he was a child, and had seen the lives of many girls who lived there.

item.title: Kurano-kunchi no Futago Jijou
item.description:

  • 日本語名: 倉野くんちのふたご事情
  • 英語名: Kurano-kunchi no Futago Jijou

别名

  • 仓野家的双子事情 The twins situation of the Kurano family

あらすじ

The 8-person Kurano household that runs the cafe Apple Pie has three sets of twins. The oldest pair is the reliable Izumi and the sporty Mikoto, followed by Kazuya and his tsukkomi-type twin Tomoka. The youngest twins are the Yamato Nadeshiko-like Yae who’s great at housework, and the ‘so cute you can’t help but hug her’ Ema. They get along well even if their parents fight constantly. However, one summer day, their parents’ arguments had escalated to divorce! His mother gained custody of Kazuya and only one of the 5 daughters. Thus begins the struggle among his sisters to be with the brother that they all love so very much.

item.title: Natsu no Ame
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CUBE
  • 発売日: 2009-09-25
  • スコア: 7.62/10 (333 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏ノ雨
  • 英語名: Natsu no Ame

别名

  • Summer Rain

あらすじ

The plot of Natsu no Ame revolves around Sousuke, a soccer loving idiot who spends his days practicing with his two friends, Takeda and Midori for the day when he is allowed to return to the soccer club he was forced to resign from.

The story begins with Sousuke recalling a memory from his past where he pondered what qualifies as a first love, thinking about a young girl he teased almost to the point of tears as a child. Upon snapping back to the present Sousuke is made aware of a beautiful girl busy with her cellphone. After knocking her out of the way of on oncoming motorcycle he finds that he had also sent her cellphone into the river.
